decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly building up a strong board presence by playing low-cost artifacts and creatures that benefit from having artifacts in play. By combining aggressive creatures with cards that draw additional cards or provide additional benefits based on the number of artifacts in play, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an early assault and maintain pressure throughout the game. The inclusion of counterspells and utility creatures adds versatility and disruption to the strategy, making it a well-rounded and formidable Aggro-Affinity deck in Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly putting out artifact creatures like Ornithopter and Myr Enforcer to create a strong board presence. By using cards like All That Glitters and Moon-Circuit Hacker, it aims to pump up the power of these creatures to deal significant damage to the opponent quickly. With cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast to help with card draw and mana acceleration, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence. The inclusion of cards like Metallic Rebuke provides some disruption to control the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying cheap artifacts and creatures to build a board presence and enable powerful spells like Thoughtcast. By utilizing cards like Springleaf Drum and Moon-Circuit Hacker, the deck can generate additional resources and protect its key threats with Metallic Rebuke. All That Glitters enhances the power of its creatures, making them big threats in combat. With a mixture of low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and efficient beaters like Myr Enforcer, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and efficient card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a board full of artifact creatures and using cards like All That Glitters to boost their power and toughness. By leveraging cards like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Of One Mind and Thraben Inspector to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. With efficient mana sources like Springleaf Drum and Seat of the Synod, this Affinity deck is designed to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield and close out games swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize control spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw effects to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. It also features evasive creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Faerie Seer to pressure the opponent and provide additional card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Maestros Theater allows the deck to generate incremental advantage and close out games in the late game.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells and removal, while also efficiently filling the graveyard to enable the casting of powerful Delve creatures like Gurmag Angler and Cryptic Serpent. The deck includes a combination of card draw and disruption spells to maintain control of the game and neutralize threats, ultimately aiming to outlast the opponent and secure victory through attrition. Additionally, Unexpected Fangs and Suffocating Fumes provide additional versatility and utility in dealing with various threats on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on using various spells and abilities to create a storm of poison infecting the opponent's creatures. The key strategy involves using cards like Prologue to Phyresis, Infectious Inquiry, and Vivisurgeon's Insight to quickly overwhelm the opponent with poison counters. The deck also includes cards like Contentious Plan and Weather the Storm to help fuel the combo and protect against opposing threats. By efficiently chaining spells together and maintaining resources, the deck aims to execute the poison storm combo effectively and swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells and removing threats with efficient removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt. The deck also aims to draw cards consistently with cards like Frantic Inventory and Preordain, while using cards like Augur of Bolas and Murmuring Mystic for added value and board presence. The deck utilizes a mix of spells and creatures to maintain control of the game, while also having options for card advantage and damage output.

This deck focuses on quickly enchanting creatures with powerful auras to boost their offensive capabilities and overwhelm opponents with aggressive attacks. With a mix of card draw, mana ramp, and hexproof creatures like Slippery Bogle and Silhana Ledgewalker, this deck aims to outpace and outmuscle opponents in a fast-paced Pauper 1 vs 1 format. By efficiently utilizing auras like Rancor, Ethereal Armor, and Armadillo Cloak, this deck can create powerful threats that are difficult to deal with, making it a formidable opponent in the metagame.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana while dealing damage with efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl, the deck can accelerate its mana production and consistently play powerful threats such as Avenging Hunter and Boarding Party. Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst provide disruption for opponents while Generous Ent and Annoyed Altisaur offer additional aggression. With a strong mana base and a curve that tops out at four mana, this Aggro Gruul deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by utilizing a combination of Gates to generate mana advantage while also employing a variety of control spells such as Counterspell and Journey to Nowhere to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Dawnbringer Cleric for additional board presence and protection. With efficient card draw and protection spells, as well as a solid mana base provided by the Gates, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory.

This deck focuses on using gates as a way to control the game, while also utilizing cards that can counter spells and remove threats from the opponent's side of the field. The goal is to establish a strong defensive position with cards like Citadel Gate and Guardian of the Guildpact, while also maintaining card advantage through effects like Brainstorm and Squadron Hawk. By combining control elements with the synergy of gates, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through careful decision-making and resource management.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a mix of countermagic, removal spells, and card draw. By efficiently managing resources and leveraging powerful threats like Gurmag Angler, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while maintaining a strategic advantage. The inclusion of cards like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour helps to maintain card advantage and dig for key pieces, while cards like Contaminated Aquifer and Tolarian Terror provide additional utility and flexibility in various matchups.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using gates to slow down the opponent's plan while countering key spells with Counterspell. It also includes removal and protection spells like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands. The deck aims to stabilize the board with creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact and Squadron Hawk, while generating card advantage with cards like Preordain and Brainstorm. The key strategy is to outlast opponents by disrupting their game plan and eventually taking control of the game with powerful creatures and spells.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells and removal spells, while utilizing card draw and graveyard manipulation to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to control the flow of the game by efficiently dealing with threats and eventually finishing off the opponent with powerful creatures such as Gurmag Angler. The combination of efficient removal, counterspells, and card advantage engines allows the deck to outvalue its opponent and dictate the pace of the game.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and creature bounce effects. By using efficient removal like Snuff Out and Cast Down, along with Counterspells to stop key threats, the deck aims to maintain control of the game while generating card advantage through cards like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours. The deck also includes some card draw and filtering with Preordain and Brainstorm, allowing the player to find the right answers at the right time to secure victory.
